text:
ron: heads-up: we're seeing nondeterministic slowdowns on heterogeneous gpu pools when runtime 5.0 picks the new fused-attn kernel. This looks like a kernel-selection regression on mixed mps+ampere nodes. thinking we should pin kernel-selection to legacy ordering in eu-west-1 for the next 12h while we debug.

deploybot: (bot) Proposed pin change: pin-window-4829 created. Use `/deploybot pin` to lock runtime config.

ivy: Can you quantify "slowdown"? p50/p99 numbers?

ron: p50 +8% and p99 +40% for medium-length prompts (1k-2k). Error rate unchanged. Repro on canary with synthetic load when hetero scheduling is enabled.

kai: Proposal: regional pin in eu-west-1 only, but do it as a config pin (kernel-order=legacy) not a full runtime rollback. That minimizes churn. Ops can apply routing rules if rollback needed.

ops: I can push the config pin. Need exact deploybot command and reason. Also need to update release notes with compatibility note for SDK edge-case: SDK v5.2 uses eager KV layout which interacts poorly with fused-attn kernel on older drivers.

ron: command: `/deploybot pin config=kernel-order=legacy region=eu-west-1 reason="hetero-kernel-slowdown" actor=ron`

deploybot: (bot) Command executed: pin-482999. Config pin applied: kernel-order=legacy in eu-west-1. Anchor ID anchor-ks-4829. Expires in 12h. Audit audit-ks-4829.

henry: Observability (15m): p50 back to baseline, p99 reduced 35%. No new errors. Good move.

ivy: I'll open a PR to add a conditional kernel-selection fallback and a driver-feature check so fused-attn is only enabled on validated drivers. Link when ready.

kai: Also flag SDK v5.2 in compat matrix: note that users doing heavy medium-length batched inference may want to pin SDK until runtime 5.0.1 ships. Add smoke eval comparing tokenization and latency buckets.

ron: leaving the anchor for 12h while we release a small runtime patch. If patch lands earlier we can unpin: `/deploybot anchor remove anchor-ks-4829 actor=ron`. Follow-up thread will include test vectors and perf diffs.

deploybot: (bot) Anchor anchor-ks-4829 will expire at 2026-03-26T08:30Z unless extended. To extend: `/deploybot anchor extend anchor-ks-4829 duration=12h`."
